claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows darker, weathered pallets stored outdoors; the report does not show cleanliness, dryness, sorting, or whether water was added.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale, weighing process, or certified weight document appears in any photo.

risks.risk: Exact dimensions (length, width, height) are not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the pallet beside a tape measure or ruler showing all three dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown or non-standard dimensions.

risks.risk: Load capacity or weight rating is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any pallet stamp, brand mark, or load rating marking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown or light-duty load capacity.

risks.risk: Wood species or treatment type is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the wood grain and any treatment stamps such as HT or MB.

risks.risk: Total quantity available for sale is not shown.
risks.proof: Wide photo or video showing the entire stack or pile with a visible count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single pallet only.

risks.risk: Detailed condition beyond visible wear, such as rot, broken slats, or infestation, is not shown.
risks.proof: Video clip inspecting all sides and the underside of the pallet or pallets.

proof_requests: Photo of the pallet next to a tape measure showing length, width, and height.
Close-up of any stamps or markings on the pallet wood.
Wide shot or video showing the full quantity of pallets for sale.
Video inspecting all sides and underside of the pallets for rot or breakage.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a wooden pallet, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified claims and hidden risks.
